# MinHook source provenance

Declared upstream base: `TsudaKageyu/minhook`, commit `8af6b4acae5a9388fd742b56fa79ece89d96f823`.
This is the gitlink recorded by the source project, not a claim that the supplied directory is a pristine checkout.

The source directory supplied to this snapshot had no independent Git metadata. Its actual copied bytes are frozen in
[SOURCE_SELECTION.json](../../SOURCE_SELECTION.json) and [SOURCE_MANIFEST.json](../../SOURCE_MANIFEST.json).
The local header and implementation include per-target batch enable/disable operations and instruction-pointer relocation;
these local changes are retained because the host and isolation tests depend on them. No upstream-update operation was performed.

Full upstream license text including the HDE32/HDE64 portions was read from the official immutable URL:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TsudaKageyu/minhook/8af6b4acae5a9388fd742b56fa79ece89d96f823/LICENSE.txt
and transcribed into LICENSE.txt with normalized UTF-8/LF text. Existing copyright/license headers in every source file remain unchanged.
This license is BSD-2-Clause; it is not first-party MIT code. The local source patch is not represented as upstream-authored code.
